about: Realistic memory tasks for the token benchmark. Each lookup task has a keyword (what an agent types into a search tool), a natural question, and an answer: a short string that must appear in what the server returns for the task to count as answered. answer=null means the vault holds no answer. All notes are fake, see bench/fixture-vault/.

arguments.title: Partial refunds API
arguments.content: Started the partial refunds endpoint. The admin screen sends a list of order_item ids; the API sums their prices in pence, checks the total against the remaining capture and calls POST /v2/payments/{id}/partial-refunds. Sandbox refunds only work on payments from yesterday, so the tests use a fixture payment dated the day before. Next: the item picker in the admin screen.
